newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold traded at US$356.95/oz in late HK - trader.
newsitem.headline: Gold traded at US$356.95/oz in late HK - trader.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold traded at US$356.95 per ounce, a three-and-a-half-year low, said a trader at an international bank in Hong Kong on Wednesday.
The market drifted lower in afternoon trade when Europe opened, dealers said.
Hong Kong gold prices drifted lower following the rebound in New York overnight, and traders said they were hoping for the trend to reverse by the time gold reached $355 per ounce.
"If it can hold at $355, then we might have a trading market instead of a one-way market," said one bullion dealer.
Some sources said that gold was under pressure from Australian producers.
Much of the selling was from U.S. funds, other gold dealers said.
